requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE beautiful isometric GAME-WORLD PLACEMENT CONCEPT for an ADVENTURERS' GUILD in our OWN existing fantasy city. The owner CANCELED the temple priest quest service and now wants a fantasy adventurers' guild with a physical paper-contract notice board.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is our OWN approved terracotta-roof city architecture and layout inspiration, specifically the quiet small TEMPLE QUARTER at the left city edge with its ground teleport seal. Propose replacing that temple BUILDING in this concept with a GUILD HALL in the same quiet quarter; keep surrounding orange-roof houses, cobblestones, modest walled gardens and connected town street. Image2 is our OWN hero C for human scale and painted character style. No reference mage/old priest must appear.
GUILD BUILDING: a clearly public TWO-STOREY ADVENTURERS' HALL at ordinary town-building scale, not an enormous castle. Warm dark timber beams, cream/ivory plaster, sturdy pale stone foundation, broad distinctive deep FOREST-GREEN pitched roof, welcoming deep porch/canopy, substantial double doorway. An original BRASS COMPASS-AND-MAP crest over the entrance signifies exploration and adventure. One small tasteful hanging wood sign may read exactly «Гильдия». Roof shape/public entrance and board make it recognizable; no religious cross, rose church window, steeple, temple masonry facade, tavern beer barrels or merchant counter/display stock. Do not copy the cobalt merchant-shop roof/scales sign.
INTERACTION FEATURE: under the porch BESIDE the doorway, clearly visible from the game camera, one large actual dark-wood NOTICE BOARD with brass edges and THREE light honey/ivory paper orders individually pinned to it. Posted sheets are physical papers with tiny ink marks/seals, not a glowing UI billboard; no readable tiny text needed. Board and doorway occupy distinct spaces. No shop goods, trading counter, new service stalls or receptionist.
PLACEMENT: broad landscape crop of this city quarter from elevated orthographic3/4 isometric camera. Entire guild roof/base/porch/board visible with safe margins; show neighboring terracotta houses and the open exit to town street so location is clear. The EXISTING flat silver/cyan ornamental GROUND TELEPORT SEAL remains separate on open paving beside the hall, completely visible, not under the porch or board, with unobstructed approach from street. No portal arch, no second new teleporter. Clear STREET→NOTICEBOARD and STREET→PORTAL routes, enough empty paving for hero to stand/interact.
Include exactly ONE small unchanged hero C near the board at believable human-to-two-storey-building scale. No priest, new NPC or crowds. Subtle warm lanterns, plants and hand-painted volumetric material texture consistent with our original city. Warm fantasy anime-adventurers-guild atmosphere rendered in our OWN painted cartoon isometric style, NOT anime faces or a franchise building. No huge aura/selection contour or floating quest marker. One coherent scene, no UI frame/insets, no map overlay, no stats/counters/lore or added services. This is proposed appearance/placement, not a native screenshot or implemented city change.

Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create ONE premium FULLSCREEN ADVENTURERS' GUILD CONTRACT BOARD interface concept for our OWN painted fantasy RPG/survival game. Landscape16:9. The owner rejected a plain ivory window with text columns. It MUST instead feel like walking up to a real beautiful guild noticeboard with PAPER JOB ORDERS pinned on WOOD, with an inviting fantasy-adventure anime guild mood, rendered as original polished game art with very legible Russian writing.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is OUR OWN fantasy city used ONLY for hand-painted warm volumetric craftsmanship/style, not for copying its temple. Image2 contains OUR OWN approved olive orc and purple ogre: use tiny ink-sketch illustrations of those enemy appearances on SEPARATE orders. No priest or temple UI, no external anime/franchise material.
SCENE/FRAME: close straight-on view of a substantial dark walnut/oak noticeboard filling almost the whole screen; warm directional lamplight from upper left, subtle wooden guildhall surrounds visible only at outer edges. Rich woodgrain, restrained engraved brass corners, pins/nails and wax seals. Beautiful maintained craftsmanship, not dirty horror or rusty junk. All text-bearing paper areas broad/flat/light and facing camera; no heavy perspective, curl, rope or shadow obscuring words. Dark wood separates pinned light ivory/honey paper sheets. No large flat-white app background, office dashboard, inventory grid, research window or giant monster artwork banner.
TOP: a narrow carved wood/brass title plate EXACTLY «Гильдия авантюристов»; upper-right small elegant «Esc · Закрыть». Upper-left a personal worn-brass guild BADGE with one large crisp F and label «Ваш ранг F». Beside it a tasteful small paper progress strip EXACTLY «Заказы ранга F: 2/3» with two completed stamped marks and one empty mark. This is PERSONAL adventurer rank, not building level. No other XP bars/currencies/wallet.
RANK BOARD SELECTOR: ONE ROW of SEVEN matching engraved metal/wood hanging tabs, letters EXACTLY in this order «F E D C B A S». F is visibly selected with restrained cyan/ivory edge. E/D/C/B/A/S remain visible but dimmed with small elegant locks. They feel like choosing another physical rank-board, NOT ordinary modern dropdowns, segmented web controls or Excel filters. No SS or SSS and no eighth rank.
MAIN BOARD: at left TWO individual paper contract notices, naturally pinned one above the other with comfortably separated edges and nearly upright text. Their layouts are readable and intentionally composed. First selected order title «Лагерь орков», small F wax seal, modest ink illustration of our ORC, two clear lines «Место: Лесная опушка» and «Награда: 50 золота · 80 XP», with small existing-style painted gold coin next to gold and a restrained XP mark. Second order title «Стоянка огров», F seal, small ink illustration of PURPLE OGRE clearly a separate posting/location, lines «Место: Каменистая поляна» and «Награда: 80 золота · 120 XP». No mixed orc-ogre camp and no new monster species. Thin ribbon/pin treatment identifies the selected orc paper, without a massive opaque color fill.
RIGHT: ONE larger selected paper order held by tasteful brass pins, light parchment with subtly aged edges, framed by the board rather than a separate modern UI panel. Content top-to-bottom, in clear dark brown/plum ink: title «Лагерь орков»; small seal «F»; section «Место» with «Лесная опушка»; section «Цель» with «Победить орков в лагере»; section «Награда» with a small GOLD COIN + «50 золота» and «80 XP». Optional tiny hand-drawn map fragment as faint decorative illustration in a clear area, no route/distance/coordinates. Bottom one substantial plum-and-brass game action button EXACTLY «Принять задание», neatly mounted over the paper's lower edge with safe padding. No separate turn-in or second accept button.
READABILITY: readable Russian fantasy UI typography, ink16–22pxorlarger at1600x900, paper text insets24px+, clear hierarchy, all labels inside safe zones, no tiny illegible paragraphs, no diagonal text, no giant blank white panels. Page edges may be organic but not ragged through content. Footer may simply say «Esc · Вернуться в город» on small wood trim.
STRICT: this is an illustrated F-rank state with2of3 success progress; next-rank trial is NOT yet unlocked. No priest, church icons, new NPC portraits, unrelated global menus/resource bar, equipment rarity/levels1–100, new currency/reputation/quest XP system, item rewards, killcounts or invented bosses. Numeric gold/XP values are illustrative visual examples only, not balance data. One finished immersive physical-board interface, not a diagram, not multiple states.
